verdictBody: Claims-based indicators remain near their 2026 lows and little changed through mid-October. September payroll growth slowed to +29K with meaningful downward revisions to July and August — worth watching, but not yet reflected in the claims ratios.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: The insured unemployment rate held flat at 1.1% for five straight weeks through Oct. 3, matching its 2026 low with no sign of climbing.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Continued claims ticked up to 1.710M (week of Oct 3) from a Sep. 19 low of 1.699M, but remain near multi-month lows even as payroll growth slowed to +29K in September.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Initial claims held near 198K-199K through mid-October, essentially flat and still well below levels that would signal labor-market stress.

stats.label: Insured Unemployment Rate
stats.note: Steady at 2026 low for 5 straight weeks

stats.label: Continued Claims
stats.note: Ticked up from Sep 19 low of 1.699M

stats.label: Nonfarm Payrolls
stats.note: Weak; July/Aug revised down a combined 60K
